title: Shared Townhouse only 35 min from Nashville.
description:
Comfortable townhouse located just Centrally Located 35 min from Downtown Nashville and 35 min to Franklin Tn.  Large bedroom with furniture included.  Large closet and Private on-suite.  Access to all shared spaces.  Smart Tvs. Fiber Speed Internet.  A contemporary feel.  I have an office downstairs if you need something printed.  Wallace And I are chill, Easy going people that work most of the time.

The space
The Room your renting is up the stairs straight on.  There is a washer and dryer up there also.

Guest access
The whole house is shared.  Find a space in the refrigerator.  If you like Coffee I got a coffee bar going next to the stove.

During your stay
Both Wallace and I are here to help you.  If you have any issues at all please give one of us a call.

Other things to note
We only have two parking spots in front of my townhome. I will want my spot.  if you have more than one car/truck there is guest parking at the end of the street.  We have a smart Lock on the front door.  a 6 digit code will be assigned to you at checkin.
